status: Transcribed published values, not newly generated simulation outputs.

optical_constants.source: Supplement Table S8 (printed page 10; PDF page 11)
optical_constants.convention: Complex refractive index n + i k; n and k dimensionless.
optical_constants.limitations: Three selected wavelength samples; insufficient for a broadband causal material fit or an accurate band-edge derivative.

TiO2_energy_velocity.normalization: Velocity divided by vacuum speed of light c; dimensionless.
TiO2_energy_velocity.analytical_source: Main article Table 1; rounded values for the approximately 98 nm O3-grown film.
TiO2_energy_velocity.fdtd_source: Main article section 3, page 3350; volume-averaged 100 nm slab results.
TiO2_energy_velocity.limitations: Averaging-window effects affect the comparison; values alone do not establish a physical energy/group-velocity difference or predict THG.
